token_topic_address.meaning: address carried by the indexed token topic of the emitted ClaimRecipientUpdated log

recipient_topic_address.meaning: address carried by the recipient parameter of the emitted ClaimRecipientUpdated log

stored_token_address.meaning: token key under which claimRecipient[user][token] is stored by _setClaimRecipient

stored_recipient_address.meaning: recipient value stored at claimRecipient[user][token] by _setClaimRecipient

assumptions: The emitted log is produced by the same _setClaimRecipient call that writes claimRecipient[user][token], so the stored and emitted fields describe one operation.

The ClaimRecipientUpdated event's indexed positions map to the declared (token, recipient) parameter order, so a correct emission places the token address in the token topic and the recipient address in the recipient topic.

unresolved.description: The report does not state concrete user, token or recipient values, so the scenario is a possible state rather than an observed incident; symbolic address fields are used.

limitations: Only the direct topic/field inversion impact indexed_token_topic_holds_recipient is formalized; the downstream potential impact indexers_construct_inverse_mapping is deferred to a future claim.
This plan captures the report-level correspondence relation between stored and emitted fields; it does not assert that any payout was actually misrouted.
No authorization, permissionless-call or payment condition is described, so none is encoded.
Code-level binding of the emit site to this relation is deferred to program-side AST generation.
